topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just found out that the surprise party planned for you got called off. I know how much you were looking forward to it, and I really wish things had turned out differently. The venue had some last-minute issues, and we couldn't find a way to fix them in time. It’s a real letdown, and I can only imagine how disappointed you must be. I hope we can find a way to make it up to you, maybe even do something even better soon. It’s just a setback, not a cancellation, right? Let’s figure out the next steps together, whenever you feel ready.
